title: Analytical Pipeline for Assembly and Annotation of Betta splendens Genome
author: Xin Liu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qq9dvz6

steps.title: Obtain raw sequencing data
steps.instruction: Collect the raw sequencing reads in FASTQ format.

steps.title: Filter reads with SOAPfilter
steps.instruction: Run SOAPfilter (v2.2) on the FASTQ files using the options '-i insertsize -y -z -p -M 2'.

steps.title: Estimate genome size via k‑mer
steps.instruction: Perform k‑mer analysis (k‑mer v1.0) with parameters 'k=17 -t 12' to estimate the Betta splendens genome size.

steps.title: Assemble genome and close gaps
steps.instruction: Assemble the genome with SOAPdenovo and then close gaps with Gapcloser, using reads from all insert‑size libraries.

substeps.instruction: Run SOAPdenovo (v2.04) with pregraph(-K 29 -p 20); contig(-M 2); map(-k 41); scaff() parameters.
Run Gapcloser (v1.12) on the SOAPdenovo assembly using the same set of insert‑size library reads.

steps.title: Build repeat library with RepeatModeler
steps.instruction: Create a de‑novo repeat library from the assembled genome.

steps.title: Mask repeats using RepeatMasker
steps.instruction: Mask repetitive sequences in the genome using the library generated in the previous step.

substeps.instruction: Run RepeatMasker (v3.3.0) with parameters '-nolow -no_is -norna -parallel 1' and the de‑novo library as the repeat database.

steps.title: Identify DNA and protein repeats
steps.instruction: Detect repeats at both DNA and protein levels against known repeat databases.

substeps.instruction: Run RepeatMasker (v3.3.0) with '-nolow -no_is -norna -parallel 1' against Repbase TE library (Version 17.01).
Run ProteinMask (v3.3.0) with parameters '-noLowSimple -pvalue 0.0001' against the TE protein database.

steps.title: Predict genes with Augustus and GlimmerHMM
steps.instruction: Perform de‑novo gene prediction on the repeat‑masked genome using two ab‑initio tools.

steps.title: Homology‑based gene prediction with BLAT and GeneWise
steps.instruction: Use protein sequences from related species to guide gene prediction.

substeps.instruction: Download protein sequences of homologous species: Danio rerio (release‑64), Gadus morhua (release‑65), Gasterosteus aculeatus (release‑64), Oryzias latipes (release‑64), Takifugu rubripes (release‑64), and Tetraodon nigroviridis (release‑64).
Align the downloaded proteins to the repeat‑masked genome with BLAT.
Run GeneWise (v2.2.0) on the BLAT alignments using parameters '--min_align_coverage 0.3 --max divergence rate 0.3 --extend length for both sides of regions 2000'.

steps.title: Integrate gene predictions using GLEAN
steps.instruction: Combine the ab‑initio and homology‑based gene sets into a consensus set with GLEAN, filtering by overlap cutoff 0.8 and requiring at least one homolog support.

steps.title: Process RNA‑seq and refine gene models
steps.instruction: Use RNA‑seq data to improve the consensus gene set.

substeps.instruction: Filter raw RNA‑seq reads with SOAPnuke using '-l 10 -q 0.5 -n 0.01 -Q 2'.
Align the filtered reads to the consensus gene set with TopHat (v2.1.0) using default parameters.
Assemble the aligned transcripts with Cufflinks (v2.2.1).
Predict open reading frames using the training parameters supplied by Cufflinks.
Generate the final, more complete and reliable gene set.

steps.title: Assess completeness with BUSCO
steps.instruction: Evaluate the completeness of the final gene set and genome by running BUSCO (v3.0.1) and mapping to the actinopterygii reference.

substeps.instruction: Map the final gene set and genome to the actinopterygii reference to obtain completeness metrics.
